fields.description: Weekly issue featuring strong editorial commentary on Coral Gables city politics and the removal of George Merrick from the city commission, along with election-related satire and commentary on Dade County politics. Includes a letter from congressional nominee Ruth Bryan Owen, discussion of convention financing (Shriners and upcoming Elks), notes on Miami Beach law enforcement and slot-machine raids, coverage of Miami Chamber of Commerce growth, and local columns and advertisements reflecting entertainment, nightlife, and Prohibition-era liquor trade.
